div.div: THE #1 FAILURE MODE: Google Cloud generates a unique service account (service-org-123456@gcp-sa-logging.iam.gserviceaccount.com) when an aggregated sink is created. It holds ZERO permissions by default. Without an explicit IAM grant of roles/pubsub.publisher on the topic, the sink drops 100% of logs silently with NO console warning.
